paperTitleZh: 化學 全新模擬卷 — 卷二 乙部 物料化學
paperTitle: Chemistry Mock — Paper 2 Section B Materials Chemistry

parts.label: a(i)
parts.questionTextZh: 解釋為什麼生物基聚乙烯在原料方面較石油聚乙烯「綠色」，並指出它在廢物處理方面為何沒有這優勢。
parts.questionTextEn: Explain why bio-based polyethene is 'greener' than petroleum polyethene in terms of its raw material, and state why it has no such advantage in waste disposal.

parts.label: a(ii)
parts.questionTextZh: 下圖顯示一種具液晶特性的分子。寫出這分子有利於形成液晶的兩項結構特徵。
parts.questionTextEn: The diagram below shows a molecule with liquid-crystalline behaviour. State two structural features of this molecule that favour liquid-crystal formation.

parts.label: a(iii)
parts.questionTextZh: 脲甲醛用來製造電插頭外殼。舉出一個原因。
parts.questionTextEn: Urea-methanal is used to make the casings of electric plugs. Give one reason.

parts.label: b(i)
parts.questionTextZh: 一個晶胞含多少個銅原子？
parts.questionTextEn: How many copper atoms are there in a unit cell?

parts.label: b(ii)
parts.questionTextZh: 根據圖中數據，計算銅的密度（以 $\text{g cm}^{-3}$ 為單位）。（相對原子質量：Cu = 63.5；阿佛加德羅常數 = $6.02\times10^{23}\ \text{mol}^{-1}$；$1\ \text{nm} = 10^{-7}\ \text{cm}$）
parts.questionTextEn: Based on the data in the diagram, calculate the density of copper, in $\text{g cm}^{-3}$. (Relative atomic mass: Cu = 63.5; Avogadro constant = $6.02\times10^{23}\ \text{mol}^{-1}$; $1\ \text{nm} = 10^{-7}\ \text{cm}$)

parts.label: b(iii1)
parts.questionTextZh: 鋁鎂合金用來製造單車車架。解釋為什麼鋁鎂合金較純鋁堅硬。
parts.questionTextEn: An aluminium-magnesium alloy is used to make bicycle frames. Explain why the alloy is harder than pure aluminium.

parts.label: b(iii2)
parts.questionTextZh: 這合金的熔點較純鋁低。寫出一個由此帶來的工業上好處。
parts.questionTextEn: The alloy has a lower melting point than pure aluminium. State one industrial advantage of this.

parts.label: b(iv)
parts.questionTextZh: 把銅製成納米粒子，可大大增加表面面積。比較相同質量的銅，分別製成直徑 10 nm 和直徑 1 000 nm 的球形粒子。前者的總表面面積是後者的多少倍？
parts.questionTextEn: Making copper into nanoparticles greatly increases its surface area. Compare the same mass of copper made into spherical particles of diameter 10 nm and of diameter 1 000 nm. How many times is the total surface area of the former that of the latter?

parts.label: c(i)
parts.questionTextZh: PET 由苯-1,4-二羧酸和乙-1,2-二醇製造。寫出這聚合的類別。
parts.questionTextEn: PET is made from benzene-1,4-dicarboxylic acid and ethane-1,2-diol. State the type of this polymerisation.

parts.label: c(ii)
parts.questionTextZh: 寫出生成 PET 的聚合方程式。
parts.questionTextEn: Write the polymerisation equation for the formation of PET.

parts.label: c(iii)
parts.questionTextZh: 解釋為什麼 PET 是熱塑性塑膠。
parts.questionTextEn: Explain why PET is a thermoplastic.

parts.label: c(iv)
parts.questionTextZh: PET 可經水解（化學回收）變回單體，但聚乙烯不可以。根據兩者的結構解釋。
parts.questionTextEn: PET can be converted back to its monomers by hydrolysis (chemical recycling), but polyethene cannot. In terms of their structures, explain this.

parts.label: c(v)
parts.questionTextZh: 寫出把 PET 製成連續長條片材的成型方法。
parts.questionTextEn: Name the moulding method for making PET into continuous sheets.

parts.label: c(vi)
parts.questionTextZh: 舉出一個理由，解釋為什麼回收 PET 瓶前須把它與其他塑膠分開。
parts.questionTextEn: Give one reason why PET bottles must be separated from other plastics before recycling.
